description: This file defines classes related to in-memory logging, including MemoryLogger, MemoryLoggerProvider, and MemoryLoggerConfiguration, used for capturing and inspecting log entries within the application.

classes.name: MemoryLogger
classes.description: A logger implementation that stores log entries in memory for later inspection.

classes.name: MemoryLoggerProvider
classes.description: Provides instances of MemoryLogger and manages their lifecycle.

classes.name: MemoryLoggerConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for setting log level for MemoryLogger.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs a message with specified log level, event, state, exception, and formatter.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a given log level is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: BeginScope
methods.description: Begins a logical operation scope (not implemented).

methods.name: CreateLogger
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a MemoryLogger for a given category.

methods.name: GetLoggers
methods.description: Returns all loggers managed by the provider.

methods.name: GetLogger
methods.description: Retrieves a specific logger by category name.
